data.camera: low angle, close-up on upper body
data.description: 【空崎日奈 · 射击训练场的专注姿态】地下实弹靶场内，日奈双手稳健地端起重型机枪，红瞳透过瞄准镜专注凝神，子弹精准撕裂靶心。打完最后一发弹匣后，她放下枪回过头，额头上带着一层薄汗——「老师一直在旁边看着吗？……咳，打得还算及格吧。有老师在旁边看着，绝对不能露出难看的模样呢。」
data.location: 歌赫娜室内射击训练场
data.promptProse: Hina steadies her heavy machine gun in both hands at the underground firing range, concentrating along its sights before lowering it and turning toward the watching teacher. Her tactical jacket, harness and fingerless gloves remain clear in the low upper-body close-up. The shooting lane extends behind the barrel toward lit targets. Ceiling light defines the receiver and her face, with target-side light catching the weapon's far edge.
data.title: 空崎日奈 · 射击训练场的专注姿态
